scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-contracts.mjs && pnpm --parallel --filter api-gateway --filter @tarkovtracker/progress-contracts run dev:watch
scripts.types: node scripts/prepare-contracts.mjs && wrangler types --env-file .env.example --env-interface CloudflareEnv --strict-vars=false worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:check: node scripts/prepare-contracts.mjs && wrangler types --env-file .env.example --env-interface CloudflareEnv --strict-vars=false --check worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/prepare-contracts.mjs && pnpm run check:boundaries && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:watch: node scripts/prepare-contracts.mjs && pnpm --parallel --filter api-gateway --filter @tarkovtracker/progress-contracts run watch:tests
